findings.title: corpus test reads working-tree bytes, not committed bytes
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed: the corpus test now reads each listed file with git show HEAD:<file>, so only committed bytes are checked.

findings.title: corpus test crashes uncaught on a malformed committed line instead of naming it
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed: a line that is not valid JSON is recorded as a failure with its file and line number.

findings.title: record-violation index is always 0 in practice, and the code relies on that implicitly
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec states the invariant (every record in a batch shares issue, step, ts and recordFields); no comment added.

findings.title: Scenario 2 is tested in a new file, not effectsSelftest or test/effects.test.mjs as DONE names
findings.disposition_rationale: The scenario is covered and passes; the DONE item allows its own file for the corpus test and the location is immaterial.

findings.title: recordFields reserved keys (issue, schema, prev) are still overwritten silently, not refused
findings.disposition_rationale: Matches the spec's pseudocode ('build record exactly as today'); behaviour predates this change.
